mission.title: Operation Myrmidon
mission.description: Strike at the commandos and find out who leads them.

phase.briefing:
Because of the commandos' brazen interference in our operations, we are launching a strike against them. I have selected you to lead this strike, {player}.
Proceed to the indicated location. Eliminate all commandos. Obtain any information possible.

enter.say: Looks like Gray found you a real hornets' nest, {player}. I'm reading a lot of hostile signs in there.

done.say: All enemies have been accounted for!
That dossier looks interesting... I'll start scanning the contents.

phase.briefing:
Your operator has completed the scan of that dossier. Very efficient... for a human.
The dossier reveals details about an individual known only as the Colonel. This person is now the focus of your investigation.
Proceed to the next location. Eliminate all opposition and search for information on this Colonel.

enter.say: I'll let you know if you find anything of interest, {player}.

objective.text: Search for information on the Colonel

done.say: Those notes look promising! Better upload them to me when you get a chance.

objective.text: Upload the notes at a hardline

phase.briefing:
Our search continues, {player}. The Colonel's exact location is carefully guarded, in a most... methodical manner. Multiple levels of security, and layers of encryption... very impressive. Very precise.
Regardless, we shall break it. The notes you obtained have been decoded. Proceed to the next location.

enter.say: I don't really know what Gray wants you to find here. Maybe he doesn't know. I'll let you know if anything stands out, though.

done.say: Bingo! Get that CD to a hardline, {player}.

objective.text: Upload the CD at a hardline

mission.finish:
Your operator has forwarded some data to us, {player}. We are currently...
Very interesting. The nature of this data was most... unexpected. Most...
This data must be processed further. Contact us in the near future.
